prompt: A pool / billiards coaching diagram, drawn cleanly from directly above. A rectangular billiard table is 8 units wide and 5 units tall, with a POCKET at each of its four corners. A single ball sits on the LEFT rail, 2 units up from the bottom-left corner. It is struck (no spin) along a straight aim-line with slope 'go 2 units right for every 1 unit up' -- i.e. heading up and to the right. The ball rolls in a straight line and bounces off the rails with equal angles (angle in = angle out), losing no speed, until it drops into a corner pocket. It bounces off exactly TWO rails (cushions) before reaching a pocket. Draw the table from above with its four corner pockets, and draw the ball's full path as a straight-segment line from the start point, reflecting off the two cushions, ending exactly in the correct corner pocket. Mark the start point with a small solid white dot, and draw a clear bright-coloured RING (e.g. magenta) around the FINISHING corner pocket -- the single corner the path ends in. Do not ring any other corner. No text, no numbers, no grid.
easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn, and ignoring whether the details are right or wrong: does this picture show a rectangular billiard table drawn from directly above, with a pocket at each corner and a path line drawn across the table? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_form: Look at this image. Is it a top-down rectangular billiard table with pockets at the corners and a path line bouncing across it? Answer ONLY 'yes' or 'no'.
reference.q_pocket: On this billiard table, ONE corner pocket is circled with a clear HIGHLIGHTED RING (the finishing pocket). Report ONLY what is actually drawn in THIS image; do NOT trace the reflections yourself. Which corner has the highlighted ring drawn around its pocket? Answer with ONLY one of these exact labels: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.

steps.target: one corner pocket drawn at a corner of the billiard table

steps.read_crop: Does this picture show one whole pocket opening at a corner of the table rather than plain cloth or only a rail edge? Answer yes or no only.

steps.target: a bright-coloured ring drawn around a corner pocket of the table

steps.ask: Is the ball's start point marked with a small solid white dot on the left rail, with a straight-segment path drawn reflecting off the cushions? Answer yes or no only.
